contracts_rationale: No new interface. The only contract change is the 403 description in contracts/charter (responses/Forbidden.yaml, openapi.yaml securitySchemes) plus a changelog fragment; /actuator/health is not a contract operation (ADR-0041 D7).
friendly_name: Container guard, actuator and single-replica ruling
purpose_context: Under epic #226 the containerized charter service refuses every request reached by a real host name, has no health endpoint a platform can probe, and has no recorded answer on replicas. This mission makes the container usable behind a named host, adds a minimal health probe without leaking configuration or secrets, pins the local loopback and missing-secret start-up rules with tests, and records the operator's one-replica ruling.
purpose_tldr: Let a container serve requests by its real host name, expose only an up/down health check, and record that a deployment runs one replica.
